'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is a [[NPC]] Artisan and manager of the [[Weapon Shops|Ministry of Development Crafting Bay]] at [[Xuanfang Hold]], [[Mengzhou]] region. A Crafting Autopuppet takes his place when he isn't available.

==Location==
{{Map Embed|Xuanfang Hold|Weapon Crafting}}

==Shop==
{{Shop/Wrapper|
|total=00,00+|vendor=Leitao|type=Weapon}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Leitao:''' Greetings. I'm Leitao from the Ministry of Development. 
:{{Icon/Quest|Dialogue Shop|20px}} I want to rearm.
:;(Open Shop)
::'''Leitao:''' The crafts here speak for themselves.
:;(Purchase)
::'''Leitao:''' Excellent taste... This is quite popular with the Xuanfang Wardens as well.
::(Not enough Shell Credits)
::'''Rover:''' (I'm running low on Shell Credits. Maybe I'll come back another time.)
:[[File:Weapon Crafting Map Marker.png|20px]] I want to craft weapons.
:{{DIcon}} About yourself
::'''Leitao:''' My father said that when I was little and told to draw lots, I stacked everything into one pile. Then put the pottery shard right on top.
::'''Leitao:''' That's how he came up with the name {{Rubi|Leitao|Stacking Pottery}}...
::'''Leitao:''' Maybe it left its mark on me. I've always had a knack for putting things in order.
::'''Leitao:''' Hand me a basket no bigger than any other Artisan's, and I'll fit three times the material inside.
:{{DIcon}} About King Auto
::'''Leitao:''' That child is called Leijia... She's my daughter, and the only family I have left.
::'''Leitao:''' When I first took up my post with the Ministry of Development, she was only knee-high... She's grown a lot in that time.
::'''Leitao:''' I used to make her all kinds of mechanical puppets to play with. Even now that she's older, she still loves collecting them.
::'''Leitao:''' If you come across any interesting Automatons, would you mind bringing them to her? I've left her some supplies, and I'm sure she'd gladly trade with you.
::'''Leitao:''' My thanks, truly.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}
